A '''Rodian Platter''' was a dish available on the menu at the [[BanthaQuik!]] food stop in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Lumchugger's Hub]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bescane/Legends|Bescane]]. It consisted of deeply oiled [[Cranker root/Legends|cranker]] roots.

==Behind the scenes==
The Rodian platter first appeared in ''[[Death-Hunter]]'' a ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' adventure included in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 9|ninth]] instalment of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' series by [[West End Games]].
